name: Peregovorschik
source:
The story centers on a 40-year-old man with a unique gift – after seeing a loved one’s suicide, he can sense others’ emotions and thoughts. Now a negotiator, he’s called to stop a 35-year-old woman from taking her life. 

Will his skills be enough to save her?

[From [url=https://saris-s.itch.io/peregovorschik]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕一名40岁的男子展开，他拥有独特的天赋——在看到亲人自杀后，他能感知他人的情绪和想法。现在，他是一名谈判代表，奉命阻止一名35岁女性自杀。

他的技能足以拯救她吗？
